comment: C ref: end.c panic() (443-450) writes the game to the files.c set_error_savefile() name, save/<uid>wizard.e, before NH_abort(); unixmain.c (306-311) then calls files.c check_panic_save() and sys/unix/unixunix.c ask_about_panic_save() before newgame() whenever no regular save file exists. Segment 0: a debug-mode Cavewoman runs #panic, answers yes and dismisses "Oops..."; the process ends on SIGABRT (terminalSignal). Segment 1: the two messages and "Start a new game instead?" appear, and n ends the program. Segment 2: Escape at the first --More-- skips the second message, y starts a new Priest game, which saves. Segment 3: the regular save file is restored without the question, the save file is not kept, and the segment stops mid-game. Segment 4: the panic file is still there, so the question comes again, and Escape ends the program. Seeds, clocks, characters and keys chosen independently.
